scripts.build: ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build
scripts.build:dev-docs: node scripts/ste-check.mjs && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro check --root dev-docs && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build --root dev-docs
scripts.build:all: bun run build && bun run build:dev-docs
scripts.audit:links: node scripts/link-audit.mjs --dist dist --base /docs --mount /dev-docs=dist-dev-docs --self-test && node scripts/link-audit.mjs --dist dist-dev-docs --base /dev-docs --mount /docs=dist --self-test
